name: Geopolymer Paving at SIJ Acroni
zag_role: Demonstration of alkali activated paving blocks
description: On 24 April 2024 ZAG presented geopolymerisation technology within the GEORIS project. KU Leuven brought a mobile unit and demonstrated production of paving blocks by the geopolymer process, and participants then viewed paving blocks already laid at the SIJ Acroni headquarters. SIJ Acroni reported on 25 April 2024 that the bicycle area in front of the steelworks building was paved with these blocks.

specifications.quote: The recipe for the pavers, which are composed of 62% SIJ Acroni’s slag and a total of 78% industrial secondary raw materials and completely cement-free, was developed by the University of Leuven, one of the partners in the project.

specifications.quote: The GEORIS consortium, co-funded by the European Commission through the EIT Raw Materials Knowledge and Innovation Community (EIT Raw Materials), brings together 11 partners from Belgium, Greece, Poland, and Slovenia and is led by the Greek company Enalos.
